TOOLING BURST T4w — Frozen Orb emission jitter + range re-bake, and two test alignments (Run C-5, E3; conductor R-C5-72/73; specs are conductor-authored — implement the spec as written and report any field the runtime cannot honour). task_id "T4w".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, T4s (r2/r3 clauses), T4v and the new row "T4w — Frozen Orb jitter + re-bake; test alignments" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/T4v/frozen_orb_spec_corrected_R-C5-72.json (the CORRECTED spec — becomes runs/C-5/specs/frozen_orb.json in this burst), runs/C-5/specs/frozen_orb.json (the literal spec the current kit was baked from), runs/C-5/t3/T4v/build_orb.py (your own bake script), export/effect_kit.py (validate_orb, orb_schedule_report, the orb block), export/godot_import.py (the G1 orb emission clock), tests/test_effect_kit.py FrozenOrbValidationTests, tests/test_godot_import.py GroundVisibilityRegressionTests, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART 1 — FROZEN ORB (conductor debts R-C5-72). (a) RANGE: the orb expires at 1.5 s × 420 px/s = 630 px; the spec now says 630 — bake and validate against 630 (range_reached TRUE at expiry; no silent 640 anywhere: kit, orb block, test). (b) EMISSION JITTER (FF-08 for a continuous stream): replace the every-2-frames metronome with a SEEDED per-emission interval drawn from {2,3} frames (kit seed; orb block field `interval_frames` becomes `interval_frames_choices: [2,3]` or equivalent — name it, validate it: every choice ≥ 1, at least two distinct choices), so that orb_schedule_report gives interval_cv ≥ 0.25 and ff08_satisfied TRUE; the spiral angle rule (120° + 17° per emission, seeded) and 3-per-revolution are unchanged; emission count over the 90-frame flight lands in [30,45]. Determinism: the same kit seed → the same emission ages (assert it: two reports equal; a different seed → different ages). (c) RE-BAKE frozen_orb_e3 from the corrected spec with build_orb.py (extend it; do not rewrite its pixel-union grouping — the 16 motion groups must stay byte-identical to the current pieces; only kit.json / the orb block / skill_spec change). Copy the corrected spec over runs/C-5/specs/frozen_orb.json (byte-identical to the artifacts file) so the literal-equality test holds. (d) Realign FrozenOrbValidationTests.test_literal_spec_schedule_range_conflict_and_renamed_kit to the NEW contract: kit skill_spec == spec file; flight_frames 90; emission ages derived from the seeded choices (assert monotone, gaps ∈ {2,3}, count in [30,45]); interval_cv ≥ 0.25; ff08_satisfied TRUE; expiry_distance_px 630; range_reached TRUE; keep the renamed-kit clause and the six bad-field ValueError subtests (add one: interval_frames_choices with a single choice → ValueError).

PART 2 — STALE TEST (T4s-r3 self-report; conductor R-C5-73): GroundVisibilityRegressionTests.test_ground_is_above_foreground_below_actors_and_owned_until_cancel asserts the Concoction decal visible at age 84. The runtime is right: the decal appears at field_end + 3 = ceil(flight_s×60) + ceil(duration_s×60) + 3 (Concoction 153, Blackwater 216 in the live trace). Re-encode the clause from each kit's OWN numbers (never a literal 84/153/216): NOT visible at 84 for both; visible with alpha > 0 at the derived age for both; the trace must sample that derived age (the class already samples it — see the last entry of the age list). Everything else in that test stays.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4w/acceptance.json): orb_schedule_report of the re-baked kit (interval_cv, ff08_satisfied, emission count, expiry_distance_px 630, range_reached); determinism pair (same seed equal, different seed differs); the 16 piece masks byte-identical to the current kit (sha256 list before/after); previously registered kits (all 16 others) byte-identical; headless trace of one cast east: orb reaches 630 px, expiry burst at the range point, children count in [30,45]; headless import exit 0; the full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; in-sandbox suite run with the two named tests GREEN and the remaining reds NAMED with their last traceback line (env reds are expected in the sandbox; name them anyway).

Tests (unittest, stdlib): the two realigned tests + the determinism/choices tests; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the two named (extend only), any kit directory except runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/frozen_orb_e3/ (kit.json and the orb block only — pieces/primitives byte-identical), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4w/, runs/C-5/specs/frozen_orb.json (the copy) and the frozen_orb_e3 kit.json. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4w"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
